doc.brief: Describes the known strictness of a filter.
doc.md:
Describes the known strictness of a filter.

Note that for filters where the strictness is not known,
`GTK_FILTER_MATCH_SOME` is always an acceptable value,
even if a filter does match all or no items.

all.brief: The filter matches all items, [`Filter.match()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Filter#method:match) will alays return true
all.md:
The filter matches all items,
  [`Filter.match()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Filter#method:match) will alays return true

none.brief: The filter does not match any item, [`Filter.match()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Filter#method:match) will always return false
none.md:
The filter does not match any item,
  [`Filter.match()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Filter#method:match) will always return false

some.brief: The filter matches some items, [`Filter.match()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Filter#method:match) may return true or false
some.md:
The filter matches some items,
  [`Filter.match()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Filter#method:match) may return true or false
